bl-2026-03-12-brent100:
Brent crude climbed past $100 a barrel on Thursday, its highest level since 2022, amid renewed concern over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

The Indian basket of crude rose to $98.4 a barrel due to the surge in Brent, PPAC data showed, lifting the cost of the roughly 85 per cent of the oil India imports.
bs-2026-03-13-importbill: India's monthly import bill is expected to widen by about $2.5 billion because of the higher Indian basket price, traders said, with crude accounting for the bulk of the increase.
rbi-2026-03-18-mpc-minutes:
Members noted that the recent increase in international crude prices poses an upside risk to headline inflation over the next two quarters.

Should headline inflation stay above the upper tolerance band, the Committee may have to consider further tightening, one member observed.
mint-2026-03-16-atf:
State oil marketing companies raised aviation turbine fuel prices by 6.2 per cent this fortnight due to the rise in Brent crude.

Fuel accounts for about 40 per cent of an Indian carrier's operating cost, so the increase feeds straight through to airline operating costs.
et-2026-03-17-aviation: Shares of listed Indian carriers fell between 3 and 5 per cent on Tuesday amid rising airline operating costs, with the aviation index closing at a four-month low.
et-2026-04-08-rupee88:
The rupee weakened to 88.12 against the dollar on Wednesday amid sustained dollar demand from oil importers.

Dealers said the Reserve Bank was seen selling dollars through state-run banks, which could slow the pace of depreciation without changing its direction.
ppac-2026-04-15-lpg: LPG imports rose 4.1 per cent in March 2026 over the previous month, with about 90 per cent of volumes transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
mospi-2026-05-12-cpi-apr: All-India CPI inflation stood at 6.4 per cent in April 2026, up from 5.9 per cent in March, with the fuel and light group contributing 0.4 percentage points of the increase.
bl-2026-05-20-rupee-record:
The rupee touched a record low of 96.90 to the dollar on Wednesday due to heavy outflows linked to oil payments and a firmer dollar index.

A weaker rupee raises the landed cost of imports, and economists said imported inflation could add 20 to 30 basis points to headline CPI over two quarters.
bs-2026-06-06-mpc: The Monetary Policy Committee voted 4-2 to keep the repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent, citing the need to assess how far the crude shock passes into core inflation.
et-2026-07-02-pump-prices:
Oil marketing companies raised retail petrol and diesel prices by Rs 2 a litre on Wednesday, the first revision in 14 months, after marketing margins turned negative due to sustained high crude prices.

The government has so far ruled out an excise duty cut, though officials said the option could be revisited if the Indian basket stays above $95.
mint-2026-08-07-trade: The merchandise trade deficit widened to $31.2 billion in July from $27.8 billion a year earlier, driven by a higher oil import bill and a 12 per cent rise in gold imports.
bl-2026-09-18-bond-selloff:
The 10-year government security yield rose 14 basis points to 7.42 per cent on Friday amid a heavier-than-expected second-half borrowing calendar.

Banking system liquidity slipped into deficit for the third consecutive session, which could keep short-term rates elevated into October.
